newsitem.title: USA: Valspar Q1 helped by acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Valspar Q1 helped by acquisition.

text.p: Valspar Corp said Monday its results for the first quarter ended January 24 were helped by operations of ValsparCoates, which was acquired in May 1996.
Earlier, Valspar reported first quarter earnings of $0.36 a share, up from $0.28 a year ago. Sales increased 14.5 percent to $189.3 million from $165.3 million.
Excluding the results of ValsparCoates, sales rose 5.8 percent, the company said.

"Our consumer and specialty products businesses registered strong double-digit sales growth while improved internal efficiencies and a stable raw material cost environment contributed to Valspar's earnings growth," Richard Rompala, president, said in a statement.
